create_TextToImageInput: create a TextToImageInput model with model name, prompt, optional size and count
build_TextToImagePipelineSD3: build a TextToImagePipelineSD3 instance and start it on CUDA or MPS device
initialize_ModelPipelineInitializer: initialize a ModelPipelineInitializer with a preset model name and type_models
run_initialize_pipeline: run initialize_pipeline on ModelPipelineInitializer to create a text-to-image pipeline
use_PresetModels: use PresetModels to check if a model name exists in SD3 or SD3_5 preset lists
